title: Makerere African Writers Conference
summary: In 1962 Makerere University hosted the first African Writers Conference in Kampala, Uganda, a gathering that dealt with the legacy of colonialism in African literature and drew writers such as Chinua Achebe and Wole Soyinka. A young Kenyan student, Ngugi, used it to ask Achebe to read his two novel manuscripts.

uncertainty.note: Both sources give the year 1962; the Makerere timeline lists a single event date of 1 June 1962, which may be a placeholder, so the day is not relied on.

importance.justification: Described by Achebe as an enormously important moment in the history of modern African literature.
